To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the rejection of monovalents electrolyte ion and organic molecule could be explained based on the equations derived from the equations of solutes rejection and solution permeating flux on porous charged membrane under the zero charge condition.
the solute rejection and the permeation flux of multi-solute solution can be predicted based on the equations for solute rejection and permeation flux on charged membrane.
the solute separation on porous charged membranes is affected by the solute composition and concentration, and the membrane surface charge density.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new approach to the study of the separation of multicomponent solutions on porous charged membrane.
the physical chemistry study on RO process.
the solute separation on porous charged membranes for multi-solute solutions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the solute rejection on porous charged membrane could be predicted by the equations of rejection and permeation flux for porous charged membrane.
the solute separation on porous membrane is affected by solute concentration,solute composition,permeation flux,porosity and pore size of membrane,membrane surface charge and solute molecular size.

the rejection of monovalents electrolyte ion and the permeation flux of neutral molecule on porous charged membrane were determined by the solute concentration, the concentration ratio of ion and neutral molecule and the concentration of ion in solution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the rejection of ion could be controlled by the membrane charge and solution pH value.The rejection of neutral molecule was controlled by the membrane pore radius and the solution permeation flux.The concentration ratio of ion and neutral molecule was related to the membrane charge,permeation flux and solution concentration.
we have developed a new method to predict the rejection and permeation flux of solutes on porous charged membrane for multi-solute system.

the equations of rejection and permeation flux of solute for multi-solute system on charged membrane were derived based on Donnan theory and the relationships of solute rejection vs pH value,permeation flux vs pH value,concentration ratio of ion vs pH value and concentration ratio of neutral molecule vs pH value were obtained.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to achieve a very high degree of rejection for the solute of interest while allowing a significant amount of the solute that is rejected to permeate through the membrane.
we have shown that the concentration ratio of ion is not constant, but rather depends on the concentration ratio of the ion.
the concentration of the ion is not affected by the ion concentration.
